title: Cut national insurance for under-25s to create jobs, Milburn report to say
description: The report being launched this week will suggest gradually reducing employment costs over five years.

title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
description: The Ukrainian president says the slowed-down internet is making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

title: Prince and Princess of Wales arrive in India ahead of meeting with Modi
description: Most of the engagements the royal couple will attend are related to the Earthshot Prize, which Prince William founded.

title: UK will have 'voice' but no vote on EU food rules in Brexit reset
description: EU minister Hamish Falconer insists Britain would have some influence on policy as part of a new deal.

title: Trident submarine returns home after record-breaking undersea patrol
description: Defence Secretary Wes Streeting was at HM Naval Base Clyde to welcome the crew after the longest deployment at sea for a British vessel.

title: Prince Harry praises war veterans on surprise visit to Ukraine
description: He has been showing support for injured veterans in Ukraine and praising the country's resilience.

title: Cancer 'sponge' tests could be offered to more people with bad indigestion
description: The "sponge on a string" tests can be done in GP surgeries, rather than hospitals, unlike endoscopy checks that use a small camera.

title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left Megaspeed in 2025, company says
description: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.

title: Brand moved from Wandsworth to category C prison, his wife confirms on podcast
description: The convicted rapist has been moved to HMP Littlehey, which houses sex offenders.
